name: Twins of Olus
description:
About This Game

18 years ago, the invasion began. Thousands were hunted, captured and possessed. Now your training is complete and it's time to dive into exhilarating battles against your corrupted foes.

In Twins of Olus, you take control of Lions, an orphaned Uthran native and his spectral partner Creo as they emerge from years of hiding after an otherworldly force invaded their homeland. Players will master the art of dual combat, seamlessly switching between characters as they battle their way through hordes of creatures, solve puzzles, collect power ups and meet plenty of quirky allies along the way.

By exploring a beautifully crafted world filled with secrets and challenges through fast paced traversal - coupled with a little creative thinking - only you can uncover the intent and identity of the nefarious force pillaging Lions' home world.

Control two characters in tandem to experience a co-op adventure as a solo player. Seamlessly swap between playstyles to make the most of either characters best attributes.

Travel together day and night uncovering alternative routes as the sun rises and sets on each region. Encounter curious and remarkable creatures who may aid or deceive you during the journey.

Dash, launch & jolt at high velocity to cover vast stretches of terrain. Activate spectral bridges shared between the living and the dead to reach places once forgotten.

Enlist a squad of potent creatures that will lend you their powerful combat enhancements. Gather rare materials along the way to unleash the full potential of their skills.

Local co-op puts you and a friend in control of each character individually to create a new way of adventuring together.
short_desc: Twins of Olus is a narrative driven twin souls-lite that follows a young warrior who is inexplicably tied to the spirit of an ancient mage. Together they must defeat an unknown nefarious force that has invaded, corrupted and possessed everything in his once utopic world.
